description: This file defines a PHP class LoggerLayoutTTCC that extends LoggerLayout, implementing a specific logging layout format (TTCC) for the log4php logging library. It includes configuration options for timestamp formatting, thread info, category prefixing, and context printing, and provides a method for formatting log events accordingly.

classes.name: LoggerLayoutTTCC
classes.description: A layout class for the log4php library that formats log messages according to the TTCC format, including timestamp, thread, category, and context information.

methods.name: LoggerLayoutTTCC
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the date format if provided.

methods.name: setThreadPrinting
methods.description: Enables or disables the inclusion of thread ID in log messages.

methods.name: getThreadPrinting
methods.description: Returns whether thread ID is included in log messages.

methods.name: setCategoryPrefixing
methods.description: Enables or disables the inclusion of logger category name.

methods.name: getCategoryPrefixing
methods.description: Returns whether logger category name is included.

methods.name: setContextPrinting
methods.description: Enables or disables inclusion of nested context information.

methods.name: getContextPrinting
methods.description: Returns whether context info is included.

methods.name: setMicroSecondsPrinting
methods.description: Enables or disables inclusion of microseconds in timestamp.

methods.name: getDateFormat
methods.description: Returns the current date format string.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a log event into a string according to TTCC layout, including optional timestamp, thread id, level, category, context, and message.

methods.name: ignoresThrowable
methods.description: Indicates whether this layout ignores throwables; returns true.
